title: FreshnessManifest
description: Per-product per-subdomain freshness manifest for the S-84 refresh pipeline

subdomain.description: Surface subdomain: reference, products, docs, blog, or kb

input_fingerprints.description: Hashes of all inputs that determine whether regeneration is needed

upstream_repo_sha.description: git HEAD of upstream clone cache

products_json_hash.description: sha256 of relevant product entry in data/products.json

template_hash.description: sha256 of concatenated theme template files for this subdomain

generator_code_hash.description: sha256 of the backing generator script (null for agent-executed surfaces)

skill_version_hash.description: sha256 of the relevant skill .md file content

config_hash.description: sha256 of the subdomain config file content

output_state.description: Current state of generated output (separate from input fingerprints)

expected_output_paths_source.description: How expected output paths are derived: site_planner_output, registry_rules, product_inventory

actual_page_count.description: Actual number of output pages found on disk

output_content_hash.description: sha256 of output content at last known good run

last_known_good_run_id.description: run_id of the last successful generation run

output_exists.description: Whether the expected output directory/files exist on disk

manifest_status.description: Overall freshness status of this surface for this product

generation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manifest was written

command_used.description: Exact command invoked to generate this surface

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this generation run

governance_status.description: Governance compliance status: COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, or null

decision.description: Final decision for this run: FRESH, REGENERATE_UPSTREAM, etc.

skip_reason.description: Human-readable reason for skipping this surface (if applicable)

changed_input_fingerprints.description: List of input fingerprint field names that changed vs stored manifest

prior_manifest_ref.description: Path to the previous manifest for this product/subdomain
